terra.problem: David's whole crowd did not leave. The men of Judah stayed with him.
Judah did not stay put. The men of Judah stayed with David from the Jordan to Jerusalem.
The mighty men march out in verse 7, not in the very next scene after verse 2.
The text says the women lived as widows; it does not call them widows outright.
The text does not say David could not wait forty days or give that as a reason for his deadline.
The text says the troops stopped, but does not say they were halted by what they saw.
The joke calls the city's name a mouthful. Papa Dorin does not joke about how a Bible name sounds or is said.
The text does not say the woman did not shout back at the army. It says she called out from the city.
The text does not say the wall was still standing when the men dispersed.
The text does not say whether the troops entered the city or that they left it standing.
The text says Joab returned to Jerusalem, but does not say he walked.
